To represent the projections of points on a common reference line ($XY$) with $35\text{ mm}$ spacing between projectors:

| Point | Position Details | Front View (TV/FV) | Top View (TV/FV) | Distance from $XY$ |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **(i) A** | $25\text{ mm}$ above HP, $35\text{ mm}$ in front of VP | $25\text{ mm}$ above $XY$ ($a'$) | $35\text{ mm}$ below $XY$ ($a$) | $a'$ above, $a$ below |
| **(ii) B** | $25\text{ mm}$ above HP, $40\text{ mm}$ behind VP | $25\text{ mm}$ above $XY$ ($b'$) | $40\text{ mm}$ above $XY$ ($b$) | Both above |
| **(iii) C** | $30\text{ mm}$ below HP, $40\text{ mm}$ in front of VP | $30\text{ mm}$ below $XY$ ($c'$) | $40\text{ mm}$ below $XY$ ($c$) | Both below |
| **(iv) D** | $25\text{ mm}$ above HP, on VP | $25\text{ mm}$ above $XY$ ($d'$) | On $XY$ ($d$) | $d'$ above, $d$ on line |
| **(v) E** | $35\text{ mm}$ below HP, on VP | $35\text{ mm}$ below $XY$ ($e'$) | On $XY$ ($e$) | $e'$ below, $e$ on line |
proTip: Always use lowercase letters with primes (e.g., $a'$) for Front Views and plain lowercase letters (e.g., $a$) for Top Views.
